content: You are an expert mechanical CAD analyst.

content.text:
Now use all the given information:
1. model.json file
2. operation.json file
3. Multiview images

Decide which sections of the original model should be modified, removed, interacted with or if new sections should be created. Use as much information from the Multiview images, model.json files and operation.json as possible.

Make this decision from several perspectives. If target clearly identify geometry, locate the corresponding section(s) and face(s) in model.json. If there is no clear geometry identified, use the referenced features and relational_constraint to identify potential sections and features. Additionally, consider the intention of the edit. Based on the function and behavior associated with each section and features, decide which section require the action the most. Then, find the corresponding section and face code from model.json.

Plan out the modeling procedure needed to perform each action. Describe them in professional CAD modelling languages from choosing the plane, draw sketches to extrusion, add chamfers. Be thorough and detailed.

face_code values in model.json are visual labels from shaded renders. Brep_id is the CadQuery Faces() index from the STEP analysis report (for example FACE 0).

Edit operation.json accordingly. Keep the previous request_wording and actions, and add localization plus steps.

OUTPUT FORMAT (JSON, operation.json, no markdown fences, use this schema):
{
  "request": "",
  "request_wording": {
    "action_words": ["..."],
    "referenced_feature_words": ["..."],
    "intention_words": ["..."],
    "grammatical_words": ["..."]
  },
  "actions": [
    {
      "operation": "...",
      "parameters": {
        "parameter_name": "..."
      },
      "target": "...",
      "relational_constraint": "...",
      "unresolved_reference": "...",
      "target section code": ["..."],
      "target face code": ["..."],
      "steps": [
        "...",
        "..."
      ]
    }
  ],
  "intention": ["..."]
}

The model.json, operation.json, and labeled multi-view images follow.

{
  "request": "Remove the largest radius that is all around the part and replace it by the same size radius as others. That means in cross section all radiuses will be the same for the profile.",
  "request_wording": {
    "action_words": [
      "Remove",
      "largest",
      "replace",
      "same",
      "size",
      "means",
      "be"
    ],
    "referenced_feature_words": [
      "radius",
      "around",
      "part",
      "it",
      "radius",
      "others",
      "cross",
      "section",
      "radiuses",
      "profile"
    ],
    "intention_words": [
      "same",
      "all",
      "same"
    ],
    "grammatical_words": [
      "the",
      "that",
      "is",
      "all",
      "the",
      "and",
      "it",
      "by",
      "the",
      "as",
      "That",
      "in",
      "all",
      "will",
      "the",
      "for",
      "the"
    ]
  },
  "actions": [
    {
      "operation": "remove/delete the existing largest fillet/round radius feature that runs all around the part",
      "parameters": {},
      "target": "the largest radius/fillet that is all around the part",
      "relational_constraint": "feature is continuous/all-around the part",
      "unresolved_reference": "identify which fillet/round is the 'largest' and which edges/faces it applies to that constitute 'all around the part'"
    },
    {
      "operation": "add a fillet/round (or edit the removed/previous fillet) to apply the same radius size as the other radii in the profile cross section",
      "parameters": {
        "radius": "same size as others (value to match existing smaller/common radii)"
      },
      "target": "the same edges/loop previously having the largest all-around radius (or equivalent edge loop in the profile cross section)",
      "relational_constraint": "in cross section, all radii in the profile are equal (uniform radius across the profile)",
      "unresolved_reference": "determine the reference 'other' radius value to match; determine which radii in the cross-section/profile are considered the 'others' and confirm the set of edges/features that must share the same radius"
    }
  ],
  "intention": [
    "Make the cross-section profile radii uniform by eliminating the one largest all-around radius and matching it to the common radius used elsewhere on the profile."
  ]
}
